review.tagline: PyTorch library of diffusion pipelines and schedulers for image generation
review.summary: Diffusers is a Python library from Hugging Face for running and training diffusion models. It provides pipelines loaded with from_pretrained, interchangeable noise schedulers, and pretrained model classes that can be combined into custom systems. It covers text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, super resolution and unconditional generation, plus audio and 3D molecule structures.
review.audience: Python developers building or fine-tuning diffusion-based generation
strengths: Loads any of 30,000+ Hub checkpoints with a few lines via from_pretrained
Schedulers, models and pipelines are separate, so custom sampling loops are possible
Docs include training and memory/speed optimization guides
Used by InvokeAI, kohya_ss and BentoML, among 14,000+ repositories
weaknesses: Library only: no web UI or HTTP server included
README gives no VRAM or RAM figures per model
Quickstart assumes CUDA; Apple Silicon is in a separate guide
needs: Models: Stable Diffusion, DDPM, ControlNet, InstructPix2Pix, DeepFloyd IF
